messages:
amar: Quick heads-up — vendor pen test scheduled Tue 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on RBAC ephemeral roles, KMS access for artifact decrypt, and audit-log retention. Any blockers?
clara: I'll coordinate RBAC. Plan: create pen-test-assessor-ephemeral role with STS AssumeRole for 4h, tag session with assessor:id. Will open PR for terraform today. Need list of S3 prefixes they'll access.
sara: S3 prefixes: s3://pen-evidence/pt-2345/* and s3://pen-evidence/shared-logs/pt-2345/*. Also we'll attach bucket policy restricting GetObject to the ephemeral role and presigned URLs for large blobs.
liam: For KMS, we can't grant direct Decrypt to external accounts. Proposal: vendor uploads encrypted artifacts to our bucket using our KMS key, we create a one-time data-key (GenerateDataKey) then wrap with vendor's public key? Alternatives: we provide short-lived decrypt lambda behind presigned URLs that streams decrypted content to auditor session. Thoughts?
clara: Prefer avoiding key material transfer. Option B: create an ephemeral user inside our account, grant kms:Decrypt on key policy scoped to resource tag 'pt=2345' and limit via condition "aws:PrincipalTag/pt". Need sec review.
amar: @clara please add decision matrix in PT-2345 ticket. We must log every GenerateDataKey and Decrypt call to CloudTrail and forward to immutable audit bucket (retention 7y). Auditor must not be able to delete logs.
sec-bot: Ticket PT-2345 created and linked: https://redwood.internal/pt/2345 — steps: RBAC PR, KMS policy draft, audit-forwarding runbook. Assigned to: @clara, @sara.
sara: For evidence handoff, we'll use artifact manifests JSON with checksums and a GPG signature. Example manifest: {"files":[{"path":"evidence.tar.gz","sha256":"<sha256sum>"}],"uploader":"vendorX","signed_by":"vendorX"} 
liam: Quick config snippet to generate presigned URL: `aws s3 presign s3://pen-evidence/pt-2345/evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 604800` — vendor will upload then send the URL to assessors. We'll set CloudWatch Event to alert on PutObject for that prefix.
amar: Triage/labeling: vuln reports go to pt-2345 triage board. Triage owners rotate weekly: @sara (week1), @liam (week2), @clara (week3). Oncall will handle high severity p1/p0 during test window.
oncall: I'm on duty Tue-Wed 09-17 UTC. If escalations hit P0, page @amar-mobile and escalate to infra-sre.
clara: Retest coordination: propose a 2-week retest window starting 2026-05-26. Vendor needs evidence of fixes, full audit log slice, and proof artifacts. We'll require signed manifests for each retest bundle.
sara: One more: we need to snapshot RBAC before changes (terraform state export + policy archive) and store under s3://audit-snapshots/pt-2345/ pre-change. This helps verify rollback claims during retest.
amar: Awesome. Action items: @clara PR for ephemeral role (due EOD), @sara set bucket policies + manifest schema (due tomorrow), @liam draft KMS approach and lambda prototype (due Fri), @oncall verify escalation playbook. I'll book a 30m sync Mon 14:00 UTC.
liam: :thumbsup: I'll start the lambda prototype — will post architecture sketch in the ticket.
clara: Added terraform draft, link: https://redwood.internal/changes/terraform/pt-2345 — tagging @sec-review. Please review before EOD.
sara: Uploading initial manifest example to ticket now.
amar: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in PT-2345 thread and ping here for blockers. :lock:
